column1: # skill-tiers.tsv — SSOT for which skills each `./run.sh setup --profile` installs (agent-config#34).
# Format: <skill><TAB><tier>. One line per tracked skills/<name> directory; tests enforce the set match.
#   core          entwurf users: needs only Pi / Claude Code / Entwurf, git, python3, gh
#   core-pending  meant for core, still carries GLG-only steps; installed as full until split
#   net           optional (--with net): needs the user's own web/API key
#   memory        optional (--with memory): needs andenken (semantic memory)
#   work          --profile work: company tools; the user configures credentials
#   full          GLG's own environment (Org/Emacs/denote/agenda/personal CLIs and services)
# Profiles: core = core | work = core + work | full = everything. --with adds net/memory to core/work.
